description: Democratic nominee for Governor Deb Haaland, Attorney General Raúl Torrez, and State Representative Linda Serrato (HD-45) announced their support for legislation developed by the Attorney General and to be sponsored by Rep. Serrato.
title: Deb Haaland, AG Raúl Torrez, and Rep Linda Serrato Announce Solutions to Protect Kids and Consumers | Deb Haaland for New Mexico
